description: Web search, content extraction, site crawling, URL mapping, and deep research from the command line — with offline search, credit tracking, and agent-native output.

novel_features.name: Credit Burn Timeline
novel_features.description: Track credit consumption over time with daily snapshots, showing per-endpoint burn rate trends

novel_features.name: Sitemap Diff
novel_features.description: Compare current sitemap against the last stored map for the same URL, showing added and removed pages

novel_features.name: Search Result Diff
novel_features.description: Re-run a previous search and show which results are new, dropped, or changed rank position

novel_features.name: Research Archive Search
novel_features.description: Full-text search across all stored research reports, returning matching excerpts with dates and queries

novel_features.name: Search-then-Extract Pipeline
novel_features.description: Search for a topic and automatically extract full content from the top N result URLs in one operation

novel_features.name: Stale Content Detector
novel_features.description: Show extracted pages and crawl results older than N days that may need re-extraction
